title: Delimiter escape hardening + preamble unification (F-30 residuals)
summary: Closed two audit MEDs on the v5 untrusted-content boundary: (1) neutralize literal </repo_content> inside file bodies before wrap so pure concatenation cannot close the region early; (2) route rte_ops_surfaces cost-preview prefix through build_extraction_prompt_prefix and frame llm_runtime comparison lane with UNTRUSTED_CONTENT_PREAMBLE. Package-wide (non-legacy) guard pins a single framing literal.

tag_break_escape.evidence: build_partition_context now calls neutralize_untrusted_repo_content_delimiters before wrap. Mutation: replacing neutralize with identity makes body text after an embedded </repo_content> land outside the first close-tag match.

preamble_gap_rte_ops_surfaces.evidence: preview_partition_usage requires build_extraction_prompt_prefix and no longer contains the Extract-from-files literal; v5 wrapper passes the shared helper.

preamble_gap_llm_runtime.evidence: run_comparison_lane accepts untrusted_content_preamble; v5 wrapper passes UNTRUSTED_CONTENT_PREAMBLE. Wiring pin asserted in test_llm_runtime_comparison_lane_accepts_preamble_kwarg.

changes_made.description: Added neutralize_untrusted_repo_content_delimiters; wired into build_partition_context wrap; pass build_extraction_prompt_prefix into ops preview; pass UNTRUSTED_CONTENT_PREAMBLE into comparison lane.
preview_partition_usage takes build_extraction_prompt_prefix; drops local prefix re-derivation.
comparison lane prepends untrusted_content_preamble when provided.
Close-tag escape test, wiring pins (R3-008 lesson), package-wide non-legacy framing guard, ops/runtime surface pins.

test_truth_harness_goldens.py.note: Included in the 26-count k-filter run alongside delimiter suite

mutation_check_close_tag_escape.evidence: Executed: real fix keeps injection inside region; identity neutralize lets injection escape. Wiring pin asserts call site in source.

scope.legacy_v3_v4: Out of scope for R3-009; framing guard explicitly excludes run_extraction_v3.py / run_extraction_v4.py (D-tier owns any port).

residual_risks: Delimiter neutralization is string-based (zero-width space). A model that treats ZWSP as significant could still see a 'close-like' token; boundary is for instruction/data separation, not a formal security sandbox.
Comparison lane framing is preamble-only (not full extraction prefix); appropriate because comparison does not use the Extract-from-files envelope.
Does not prove live models resist injection — only that the boundary is uniformly applied.
